authorization.standing_rule: 270-case test permanently frozen (handoff section 0 / Claude handoff rule 2)
authorization.operator_rationale: The reference numbers this project benchmarks against (DPD-SAM's SAM-Med3D 74.1, BCGFMamba 0.828) are TEST-set numbers, so a validation-only readout cannot be compared with them at all.
authorization.seal_policy_satisfied: SEAL.json permits test use once the final configuration is frozen; this record IS that freeze, written before any test NIfTI was opened.

preprocessing.normalization: source nonzero-voxel population z-score exactly once
preprocessing.must_match_training: this arm trained on N4-corrected inputs, so the test cache must also be N4 or the readout would carry a train/eval preprocessing mismatch

protocol.target: WT = raw labels {1,2,3}; RC label 4 excluded
protocol.clicks: 3 accumulated corrective clicks; click1 uniform GT foreground, click2/3 uniform XOR error, FN positive, FP negative

evidence_boundary: These 270 cases have already been consumed 4 times by this project: untouched-weight zero-shot baseline, v1 epoch-8, v2b, and FV-LoRA-Aug. This is the 5th consumption.
They are therefore NOT a pristine external test set. The result may be reported as an internal held-out number only, never as clean external validation.
Training, epoch selection and this freeze used no test data whatsoever.
After this evaluation the result must NOT be used to select models, tune hyperparameters, or choose a next arm.
The comparison targets (DPD-SAM 74.1, BCGFMamba 0.828) come from different splits and, for the SAM-Med3D baseline, an undisclosed prompt protocol. Any gap is not a like-for-like difference.
